title: Binary duality and restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$, and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate one of the states free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. Restricting the Boolean dual of $f$ according to $\rho$ gives the binary Boolean dual of the restriction of $f$ according to the coordinatewise negation of $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A coordinate restriction on all $n$ coordinates
